Boots over the network. Installs without USB.

The recommended configuration includes iPXE in the firmware. It loads the installation environment over the network and prepares the gateway without a USB stick.

View the device at Protectli ↗

The VP4651 is a reference, not an exclusive requirement. We validate each alternative against the base system, the network and the services required.
